New project: the self-hosted sharing relay that replaces Cloudflare tunnels. A `share-relay` CLI (render / provision / deploy / dns / list / destroy) manages SNI-passthrough frps relay instances on OVH Public Cloud -- the relay never terminates TLS and holds no per-share state; every frpc Login/NewProxy is authorized by a callback to the remote-service-connector, and per-region wildcard DNS plus nftables rate limiting are managed alongside.
